input.reason: "Make the watchlist easier to use" translated into three concrete, testable usability wins on the watchlist screen: filter the list by status (all / still to watch / watched), an A–Z title sort toggle, and a one-click "clear watched" bulk action. The bulk action needs one new store method (clearWatched), the rest is additive component work with screen-reader announcements via the existing announcement signal. No existing behaviour or tests change.

steps.instruction: Add one new public method to WatchlistStore: clearWatched(): void. It must remove every item whose watched === true, keep the remaining items in their current relative order, persist the result to localStorage exactly the way the other mutating methods (add/remove/toggleWatched) do, and keep the items/count/watchedCount signals consistent (after a call that removed items, watchedCount() is 0). Calling clearWatched() when nothing is watched must be a harmless no-op (list unchanged, still persisted consistently). Do not change or remove any existing member, signature, or behaviour; the existing spec must keep passing.
steps.interfaceChange:
// new member of the exported WatchlistStore class
clearWatched(): void;

steps.instruction:
Improve the watchlist screen with three additive usability features. Keep every existing member and its behaviour (store, movies, imageBase, watchedCount, progress, announcement, toggleWatched, onRowClick, remove) and keep the existing spec green.

1. Status filter: add `filter` (WritableSignal<'all' | 'unwatched' | 'watched'>, initial value 'all') and `setFilter(value)` which stores the value and writes a short user-facing message into the existing `announcement` signal (e.g. 'Showing all movies', 'Showing movies still to watch', 'Showing watched movies').
2. Derived view: add `visibleMovies`, a computed Signal<WatchItem[]>: start from this.movies(), drop items that do not match the filter ('unwatched' keeps watched === false, 'watched' keeps watched === true), then, only when sortAZ() is true, sort case-insensitively by title (e.g. a.title.toLowerCase().localeCompare(b.title.toLowerCase())); when sortAZ() is false keep the store order. Never mutate the underlying array.
3. A–Z sort: add `sortAZ` (WritableSignal<boolean>, initial value false) and `toggleSortAZ()` which flips it and updates `announcement` with a short message.
4. Bulk clean-up: add `clearWatched(): void` which calls this.store.clearWatched() — watchlist-store is adding this method in this same round, signature `clearWatched(): void` — and sets `announcement` to a short confirmation.

Template changes: render visibleMovies() instead of movies(); add controls for the three features — filter buttons (All / To watch / Watched) with aria-pressed reflecting the active filter, an A–Z sort toggle button, and a 'Clear watched' button (hide or disable it when watchedCount() === 0). All controls must be real <button> elements usable with the keyboard. When visibleMovies() is empty but movies() is not empty, show a 'no movies match this filter' style message instead of the empty-watchlist message; keep the existing empty-list message when the whole list is empty. Keep the existing row markup and class names so existing tests still find them.
